config.label: Member access token from your own LinkedIn app, with r_ads and r_ads_reporting
config.description: Member access token from your own LinkedIn app, with r_ads and r_ads_reporting. Keep it secret.

config.label: Programmatic refresh token
config.description: Programmatic refresh token. With the client ID and secret, the token is renewed in memory.

config.label: Client ID of your LinkedIn app, needed for refresh
config.description: Client ID of your LinkedIn app, needed for refresh.

config.label: Client secret of your LinkedIn app, needed for refresh
config.description: Client secret of your LinkedIn app, needed for refresh.

config.label: Comma-separated numeric ad account IDs this server may access, 1 to 100
config.description: Comma-separated numeric ad account IDs this server may access, 1 to 100. Required even for reads.

config.label: Scopes actually granted to the token
config.description: Scopes actually granted to the token. When set, writes require rw_ads.

config.label: true exposes the 15 write tools
config.description: true exposes the 15 write tools. Defaults to false.

config.label: LinkedIn-Version header as YYYYMM
config.description: LinkedIn-Version header as YYYYMM. Defaults to 202608.

config.label: debug, info, warn or error
config.description: debug, info, warn or error. Logs go to stderr. Defaults to info.
